envelope.description: Controller jobs and emit_calls frames within the measured envelope

body.title: Controller jobs and emit_calls frames within the measured envelope
body.summary: The controller path keeps one ReviewJob per dimension in the step state; when the review does not fit today's single frame it emits next 'emit_calls' frames (calls with callId, dimension, stage, prompt, schema; no grounding or legacy prompts), planned with a per-call budget of controllerFrameChars minus the measured frame envelope and packed while the serialised frame fits. A review that fits one frame is exactly as today.
acceptanceChecks: Every serialised emit_calls frame fits controllerFrameChars, including a call near the frame budget.
A review that fits one frame produces today's emit_judgements frame unchanged.
